kapak.alt: The surprising name in the Rinne test

youtube.baslik: Can a positive test result be normal? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the Rinne test, if the sound is heard louder in front of the ear (air conduction) than on the mastoid bone (bone conduction), the result is Rinne positive; this is what we expect in a normal ear. A negative result suggests a conductive problem.

instagram.kanca: Can a positive test result be normal?
bilgiler: The fork goes first on the mastoid bone, then in front of the ear.
If it sounds louder by air, the result is Rinne positive.
Here, the word positive means normal.

sahneler.alt: Rinne positive: the expected result in a _normal_ ear
cumleler: The tuning fork is first placed on the mastoid bone.
Then its prongs are held in front of the ear canal.
If it sounds louder by air, the result is Rinne positive.
Here, the word positive means normal.
Louder by bone is Rinne negative, suggesting a conductive problem.
